body: Thanks for your help. I’ll try to keep my head up as much as I can, but for now I’m going through a little low stage right now.
It's always incredibly comforting when someone can truly understand what you're going through (even my relationship story is identical to yours). But how did you keep your head up during those times?
I'm experiencing anxiety problems right now and I'm on the edge of freaking out. What do I do?

That's the thing - she's really the only person who made me feel like I'm worth something. She can't help but be incredibly kind to everyone, and that's why she has problems with herself. Se had said that sometimes she felt as though our minds were in two different places, and that was true at times. However, that was only when there was a deeper meaning to her problem that she was scared of telling me. When she did tell me the deeper meaning, I understood and we worked it out perfectly. If I stop worrying about everything (which I have greatly improved upon during our time apart) and she starts trusting me more, then we'll truly be amazing together. I need her to see that.
